snippet.title: Hibimon Moments — Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hibimon Moments on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5108710/

The gameplay trailer for Hibimon Moments is here!

Explore the city and search for the mysterious creatures known as Hibimon.

Piece together diary fragments, explore different locations, play small mini-games, and capture the Hibimon you find with your camera to add them to your collection.

This trailer features gameplay from the current development build and gives you a closer look at what you’ll be doing in Hibimon Moments.

We’ll also be bringing the latest playable build to Tokyo Game Show 2026.

Add Hibimon Moments to your Steam wishlist and follow us for more updates!
